description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of tokens" and the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" for two different configurations, each accompanied by a shaded region likely representing variance or error margins. The x-axis represents the "Number of tokens" on a linear scale, with data points ranging from 0.5 to 1.5 and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The plot features two solid lines, both utilizing solid circle markers. The first line, depicted in pink with an obscured legend label, begins at an x-value of 0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1. It experiences a slight decline to 54.3 at x=0.7, rises to a peak of approximately 57.9 at x=1.0, and then generally declines, with a minor rise at x=1.4 to 53.5, before ending at its lowest point of approximately 50.9 at x=1.5. The second line, labeled "w/o material information" and depicted in purple, starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 52.5. It reaches a local peak of 54.1 at x=0.7, maintains a relatively steady trend between 53.3 and 52.4 from x=0.8 to x=1.2, dips to 51.7 at x=1.3, rises to 53.3 at x=1.4, and concludes with a sharp decline to its lowest point of approximately 47.9 at x=1.5.
